ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Algorithms can adjust parameters, but operators still determine the cause of an abnormal event.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 18,100 Chemical Plant And System Operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 17,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,100 jobs, with approximately 1,600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $73,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chemical Plant And System Operators, but it will substantially change their focus. DCS automation, alarm prioritization, and automated reports free operators from constant parameter watching. Future operators act more like plant doctors: AI and automation maintain routine operations, while people diagnose exceptions, execute complex startups and shutdowns, and respond to extreme conditions. Human judgment during the first minutes of an incident remains irreplaceable.
ai_s2_accel: AI recommendations for optimal process parameters
Intelligent alarm prioritization that reduces false-alert interference
Digital-twin plants for training and exercises
Predictive maintenance that identifies equipment risks early
ai_s2_auto: DCS automatic parameter control and alarms
Automated production reports and shift-handover records
Automated process-data collection and analysis
Mobile digital inspection records
ai_s3_list: Exception diagnosis: finding the real cause behind an alarm requires process knowledge and field experience.
Emergency response: prioritize emergency shutdown, depressurization, and leak containment within minutes.
Field sensing: sensors do not always capture abnormal sounds, odors, and vibration.
Startup and shutdown coordination: large-plant transitions require precise teamwork.
Accountability: people make final safety decisions and bear the consequences.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure tier. Automation and AI take over much monitoring and recordkeeping, while field and emergency work has limited AI exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not imply job contraction; it raises the content of the role. Operators who read DCS and understand automation principles are increasingly valuable, while purely manual roles decline. Use AI as an assistant and move from maintaining parameters to managing the plant.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study chemical engineering, mechatronics, or automation. Vocational chemical programs provide strong employment paths. Master DCS simulation and safety standards in school, then join a large chemical industrial park and progress from field work to control-room operations.

Build DCS, instrumentation, electrical, and automation knowledge instead of limiting yourself to field valves. Learn digital twins and predictive maintenance, then develop as a plant doctor with options in management or process roles.

People with chemical, electromechanical, or electrical backgrounds transition fastest. Applications should name systems operated, abnormal conditions handled, credentials earned, and the candidate's safety record.

Hire operators based on exception-handling examples and emergency awareness, not education alone. Train control-room staff in AI optimization and digital twins, and capture experienced workers' response knowledge in a procedure library.

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读化工、机电一体化或自动化专业，职业院校的化工方向就业率一直不错。在校把 DCS 仿真、安全规范学扎实，毕业进大型化工园区，倒班几年就能当内操。

有化工、机电、电气背景的人转型最快。求职时写清你会操作哪些系统、处理过什么异常工况、考了哪些证，安全记录比什么都重要。
招操作员别只看学历，要看异常处置的案例和应急意识。给内操配 AI 优化与数字孪生培训，把老师傅的处置经验沉淀成预案库，比加人更管用。

Pilots who make decisions and handle emergencies become scarcer as systems improve. Pilots limited to checklist-based cruise work face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong theory and flight hours in aviation school. Pure cruise work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop decision-making early.
Move beyond cruise flying by learning flight planning and emergency response. Strengthen meteorology skills and work toward captain qualification.
Highlight flight hours and licenses, and state which aircraft types you have flown. General aviation employers value stable, precise performance.
Do not assess candidates only by flight hours. Test operational judgment. Pilots who can bring an aircraft down safely justify higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Autopilot adoption is reducing hands-on cruise work.
Takeoff, landing, and operational judgment create opportunities.
Pilots with strong emergency-response skills are in greater demand.

body: Commercial Pilots fly charter, cargo, aerial photography, and other nonscheduled missions. They manage flight plans, takeoffs and landings, and onboard safety (O*NET 53-2012.00).
career_ai_description_block.heading: Autopilot can handle cruise, but pilots still decide when to change routes, how to recover from a stall, and how to land safely.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动驾驶能巡航，但哪条航线该改、怎么处置失速、落地怎么把稳，还是飞行员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年商业飞行员在岗约 5.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.83 万人，净增约 0.29 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.66 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代商业飞行员，但会压缩巡航段。自动驾驶与智能导航把常规飞行提速，飞行员从「握杆飞」挪向「计划制定、起降决断、突发处置、安全看护」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准巡航的，会决断会处置的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 航线智能优化
燃油智能调度
风险智能预警
起降辅助提示
ai_s2_auto: 自动驾驶巡航
智能导航规划
自动气象推送
飞行日志生成
ai_s3_list: 起降决断：时机靠人定。
突发处置：失速靠人控。
天气判断：改线靠人辨。
安全看护：红线靠人守。
乘客/ cargo 责任：兜底靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的飞行区——自动驾驶已加速，但起降与决断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「巡航握杆」动作，不是「起降决断与安全看护」的岗位。会决断、会处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会按表巡航的飞行员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 航校起步多练理论和小时，AI 时代纯巡航在缩，早点练决断。
从「飞巡航」升级成「做计划 + 处置突发」，学气象，争取机长。
突出小时和执照，写清飞过哪些机型。通航看重稳和准。
选人别只看小时，要看有没有决断脑子。能落地的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动驾驶普及，巡航段缩。
起降与决断带来机会。
会处置的飞行员更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 44,800 Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 47,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,400 jobs, with about 3,500 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $96,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will reshape their workflows. Tools take over repetitive and structured work, while teachers focus on judgment, accountability, explanation, and original research. Formulaic instruction faces pressure, while educators who connect theory to real systems and guide students become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use learning data to assess student progress faster.
Use simulations and sandboxes to demonstrate computing concepts faster.
Use retrieval tools to verify technical literature and academic policies.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate coordination across teaching and research teams.
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of structured course documents and reports.
Repetitive learning-data processing and classification.
Rule-based initial assignment checks and course scheduling.
Computer science knowledge-base search and key-point extraction.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real teaching and research settings.
The ability to explain computer science to beginners and nontechnical audiences.
Accountability and final review for teaching and research outcomes.
Cross-disciplinary resource integration and interpersonal coordination.
Reuse of tacit knowledge from long teaching and research experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this career in the relatively high AI exposure range. AI can assist lesson preparation, coding feedback, literature review, and research workflows, but teaching judgment and final accountability remain difficult to replace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 8/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong computer science and teaching fundamentals, then gain experience through real courses and research projects.
Connect existing technical or industry experience to computer science education and identify a differentiated teaching or research focus.
Turn teaching and research experience into reusable curricula, labs, or program-management systems to increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive preparation and grading work, then focus on instruction, mentoring, and research decisions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Draft course materials and research plans
Core computer science teaching and research work

ai_s7_trends: Computer science teaching and AI collaboration become standard, making tool fluency an entry requirement.
High-value teaching judgment, mentoring, and research responsibility become scarcer.
Faculty roles combine deeper subject expertise with program management and applied research.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代教师计算机，但会重塑Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。

用模拟与沙盘加速Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary的方案推演。

对Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary初步筛查与排程。
Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary知识库检索与要点提取。
ai_s3_list: 真实Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary资源整合与人际协调。
Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary长期经验的隐性知识复用。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分逻辑：Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary可被 AI 辅助，但「专业判断」与「责任终审」难替代，故8/10 曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 8/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary基础打牢，积累真实项目。

把Computer Science Teachers, Postsecondary经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can read fault codes and suggest a repair path in seconds, but a technician still has to lift the engine, replace the head gasket, and set injection timing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 805,600 Diesel Service Technicians And Mechanics were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 839,200 by 2034. That represents about 33,600 additional jobs and roughly 70,000 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $49,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Diesel Service Technicians And Mechanics, but it will change diagnosis. Systems handle fault-code retrieval, manual searches, and maintenance reminders. AI also predicts faults from historical data. Machines cannot replace under-vehicle work, disassembly, fault confirmation, adjustment, and road testing, so near-term demand remains stable.
ai_s2_accel: AI predicts faults from data and reduces unfocused troubleshooting
Remote diagnostics and data transmission for technical assistance
Automated analysis of emissions and performance data
Pilot use of AR glasses for assembly guidance
ai_s2_auto: Digital fault-code retrieval and diagnostic lookup
Intelligent searches of repair manuals and wiring diagrams
Automated maintenance reminders and work-order management
Systematic repair records and customer files
ai_s3_list: Heavy physical work and hands-on disassembly: large parts demand experience with sequence and torque.
Diagnosing difficult faults by sound and feel: data points in a direction, but engine feedback guides the final judgment.
Responsibility for repair decisions: technicians decide repair scope, replacement needs, and how to explain the work to customers.
Adaptation during emergency repairs: technicians recover disabled vehicles in limited roadside conditions.
Whole-system judgment: mechanical, electronic-control, and emissions systems interact and require integrated troubleshooting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places Diesel Service Technicians And Mechanics in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Limited desk work, including diagnostic lookup, work orders, and maintenance records, is increasingly automated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. AI improves diagnostic efficiency, while on-site disassembly and adjustment rely more heavily on technicians. Traditional mechanics who cannot use diagnostic equipment face pressure. Technicians combining electronic-control and data skills become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study automotive repair, electromechanics, or new-energy vehicles and train at a heavy-truck or construction-equipment workshop. Focus on electronic-control systems and diagnostic equipment to build an advantage over traditional mechanical repair.

Master electronic-control diagnostics and data analysis, then take on emissions and new-energy power-system work. Progressing from disassembly skills to electronic diagnosis can raise earning potential.

Career changers with mechanical or automotive-repair experience should add electronic-control knowledge before earning trade credentials. Résumés should name solved faults, diagnostic equipment used, and vehicle types repaired.

Do not hire diesel technicians based only on years of experience. Assess electronic-control capability and diagnostic reasoning. A technician who independently locates faults with a diagnostic computer offers more growth potential than one who only replaces parts.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Search manuals and wiring diagrams by fault
Safe, lower-effort handling of heavy parts
Work orders, maintenance schedules, and customer records

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent diagnostics spread as AI prediction and remote diagnosis reduce unfocused troubleshooting. Technicians shift from trial repairs to confirmation and corrective action.
New-energy heavy trucks gain share, pushing traditional diesel repair toward electronic controls and new-energy power systems. Technicians who understand both systems are in demand.

The installed base of diesel engines remains large. Logistics and construction repair demand should stay stable over the next several years, while a skills gap raises the value of experienced technicians.

body: Diesel Service Technicians And Mechanics diagnose, maintain, and repair diesel engines and their transmission, braking, and electrical systems. They work on heavy trucks, buses, construction equipment, and agricultural machinery, providing essential technical service for transportation and heavy equipment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒读故障码、给出维修思路，但吊起发动机换缸垫、调喷油正时的那双手，还得是维修技师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年柴油设备维修技师与机械师在岗约 80.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 83.92 万人，净增约 3.36 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.00 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.97 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代柴油机维修技师，但会改变诊断方式。故障码读取、维修手册检索、保养提醒这些桌面活被系统接管，AI 还能根据历史数据给出故障预判。但钻车底拆装、确认故障、调校试车的现场手艺，机器替代不了——这个岗位短期非常稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 根据数据预判故障，减少盲目排查
远程诊断与数据回传辅助技术支持
排放与性能数据自动分析
AR 眼镜辅助装配指导进入试点
ai_s2_auto: 故障码读取与诊断查询电子化
维修手册与电路图智能检索
保养提醒与工单管理自动化
维修记录与客户档案系统化
ai_s3_list: 现场拆装的重体力与手艺：几十公斤的零件，拆装顺序、力矩把握靠经验。
疑难故障的听声辨症：数据给方向，发动机的声音和手感才是最终判断。
维修决策的责任：修到什么程度、换不换件，跟客户解释清楚靠人。
应急抢修的应变：车在半路趴窝，现场条件简陋，怎么救靠技师。
多系统的综合判断：机械、电控、排放相互影响，整体排查靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面事务有限且正被自动化——诊断查询、工单、保养记录都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 提升的是诊断效率，现场拆装和调校反而更依赖技师。真正被挤压的是不会用诊断设备的传统机修，懂电控、会用数据的复合技师更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选汽修、机电或新能源车辆相关专业，进重卡或工程机械维修厂实习。重点学电控系统与诊断设备，这是与传统机修拉开差距的关键。
把电控诊断和数据分析用熟，主动接排放、新能源动力系统的活。从「会拆装」升级为「懂电控、能诊断」，收入会明显上台阶。
有机械或汽修基础的转行者，先补电控知识再考等级证书。简历上多写「解决过哪些典型故障、会哪些诊断设备、修过什么车型」。
招柴油技师别只看「年头」，要看电控能力和诊断思路。会用诊断电脑、能独立定位故障的技师，比只会换件的老师傅更值得培养。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 故障码读取、数据流分析
喷油器、传感器、ECU 检测
按故障反查手册与电路图
历史数据关联、预判故障点
工单、保养计划、客户档案

ai_s7_trends: 诊断智能化普及，AI 预判与远程诊断减少盲目排查，技师从「试修」转向「确认与处置」。
新能源重卡渗透加快，传统柴油维修向电控与新能源动力转型，懂双系统的技师吃香。
存量柴油机保有量巨大，物流与工程维修需求未来五年仍稳定，技能断层反而抬高技师身价。

body: 柴油服务技师与机械师负责柴油发动机及其传动、制动、电气系统的诊断、保养与维修，涵盖重卡、客车、工程机械与农用机械，是交通运输与工程设备领域的核心维修技术岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Models can handle literature searches and statistical runs, but people still decide whether an outbreak warrants an escalated response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 12,300 Epidemiologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 14,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,000 jobs, with about 800 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $84,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Epidemiologists, but it will reshape their analytical workflow. As AI takes over data cleaning, literature mining, statistical modeling, and genomic analysis, specialists shift from running analyses to framing questions, judging causality, and making public health decisions. People who can set direction under uncertainty and accept responsibility for conclusions remain scarce.
ai_s2_accel: Real-time forecasting and simulation of transmission trends
Automated multidimensional screening of risk factors
Rapid simulation of intervention effects
Automated first drafts and visualizations for reports
ai_s2_auto: Automated cleaning and anomaly detection for surveillance data
Large-scale automated searches of literature and evidence
Automated statistical modeling and parameter recommendations
Automated genomic and sequence alignment analysis
ai_s3_list: Field investigation: people conduct sampling and interviews.
Causal judgment: correlation is not causation, and people make that determination.
Public health decisions: people decide when to escalate a response.
Cross-domain coordination: people connect clinical care, disease control, and policy.
Ethics and communication: people remain responsible for risk communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure in this analytical occupation. Automation handles many data tasks, while people retain responsibility for investigation and decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. AI replaces statistical runs and searches, not the occupation. Specialists who frame questions, determine causality, and accept responsibility become more valuable. People limited to mechanical statistics and no fieldwork face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in preventive medicine and statistics, then practice programming and epidemiological methods while in school. In the AI era, causal judgment and field experience matter more than running analyses alone.
Move from analysis into decision support. Learn modeling and policy, seek field or management assignments, and do not remain in mechanical statistical work.
Highlight data skills and field experience, including the outbreak investigations you have completed. A public health background and published research provide an advantage.
Do not hire on statistics scores alone. Evaluate causal reasoning and field experience. Specialists who can set direction independently and accept responsibility merit higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Surveillance and modeling continue to automate, shifting specialists toward decision support.
Emerging infectious diseases and chronic disease prevention create long-term demand.
Professionals who combine data, field, and policy skills are more competitive.

body: Epidemiologists collect and analyze population health data. They study the occurrence, distribution, and risk factors of disease and injury, investigate outbreaks, evaluate surveillance, and propose prevention strategies. The occupation is central to evidence-based public health decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 文献检索和统计跑数能交给模型，但「这波疫情要不要升级响应」，还得人拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年流行病学家在岗约 1.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.43 万人，净增约 0.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。

报告初稿与可视化的自动生成

文献与证据的大规模自动检索
统计建模与参数推荐的自动化
基因组与序列的自动比对分析
ai_s3_list: 现场调查：采样与访谈靠人跑。
因果判断：相关不等于因果，靠人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace ophthalmic medical technicians, but it will take over some image-reading work. AI increasingly performs the initial screening of fundus photographs and OCT images, shifting technicians from interpreting images to operating equipment, controlling quality, and communicating with patients. Machines cannot replace the execution of complex tests or the adjustments required between equipment and patients. Technicians who understand equipment and communicate well will have more stable prospects.

ai_s3_list: Hands-on equipment skill: good images depend on a person adjusting the probe angle and securing patient cooperation.

Execution of complex examinations: special positioning and unusual conditions require real-time adaptation.
Smooth collaboration with physicians: understand which data matter most.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 indicates that AI is rapidly taking over the desk-based and image-interpretation parts of this occupation. AI can assist with image reading, reports, and data organization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over the image-reading stage, while the examination stage remains. Equipment operation, patient communication, and quality control become even more important. Pure interpretation roles will shrink, while technicians who can operate equipment and communicate effectively become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose optometry, medical imaging, or nursing, and complete a hospital internship. Develop both equipment operation and patient communication skills instead of focusing only on reading images.

Master advanced equipment such as OCT systems, fundus cameras, and visual field analyzers, and proactively take on quality control and training. Advance from performing examinations to a combined role in examination quality and patient service, and earn credentials such as optician certification.

A medical background is best, but candidates without one can start in outpatient guidance or assistant roles and then earn certifications. On your resume, emphasize the equipment you have operated, how many patients you served each day, and how you handled difficult examinations.

When hiring technicians, assess operating proficiency and patient communication, not just education. Candidates who can use AI-enabled equipment well while securing patient cooperation offer a rare combination.

Smarter equipment increases examinations per technician, shifting the role toward a combination of examination, quality control, and patient service.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代眼科医疗技术员，但会拿走一部分「读图」的活。眼底照片、OCT 图像的初筛越来越多由 AI 完成，技术员从「判读图像」转向「操作设备、把控质量、沟通患者」。复杂检查的执行、设备与患者的磨合，机器替代不了——懂设备又会沟通的技术员反而更稳。
